verdict.rationale: The docs say traces can be filtered, exported, shared and compared via the UI or the API. LangSmith also ships official Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs (the GitHub SDK repo is in the pack) and an official MCP server, so the product can clearly be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: a published API reference or OpenAPI spec (probes of the docs domain returned 404), evidence that the API covers datasets, evaluations, alerts and dashboards rather than just traces, and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.
